Package index

Estimators

Top-level MRN, IPTW and CRN linear-weighted Hajek estimators. All three share the same interface and return the overall, direct, indirect and total causal effects, all well-defined marginal and non-marginal population average potential outcomes, and variance estimates for every quantity.

mrn()
MRN estimator (marginal Radon–Nikodym weights)
iptw()
IPTW estimator (inverse-probability-of-treatment weights)
crn()
CRN estimator (complete Radon–Nikodym weights)

Identification weights (internal)

Per-unit identification weight constructors and assignment-law helpers.

.calc_treatment_probability()
Within-cluster / cluster-level assignment probability
.marg_rn_weights()
Marginal Radon–Nikodym (MRN) identification weights
.complete_rn_weights()
Complete / joint Radon–Nikodym (CRN) identification weights
.iptw_weights()
IPTW identification weights
.own_treatment_prob1()
Per-unit own-treatment probability under a within-cluster regime

HAC variance kernels and matrix operations (internal)

Dependency kernels, PSD projections and covariance assembly.

.kernel_K3_plus()
Unit-level interference kernel K3+
.cluster_kernels()
Cluster kernels for the general (MRN / IPTW) variance estimator
.sigma_from_kernel()
HAC covariance from a kernel
.lowner_max()
Loewner maximum of two symmetric matrices
.bias_correction_matrix()
Bias-correction matrix under complete randomization
.psd_via_eigen()
PSD projection via dense eigendecomposition
.psd_via_shift()
PSD correction via diagonal shift

Estimand assembly and engine (internal)

Estimand enumeration, Hajek estimates and the shared estimation engine.

.po_specs()
Canonical potential-outcome specifications
.effect_specs()
Causal-effect contrast specifications
.is_well_defined()
Well-definedness of a potential outcome
.estimand_weight()
Per-unit identification weight column for one estimand
.lw_estimand()
Hajek linear-weighted estimate and contribution column
.assemble_Sigma()
Assemble the HAC covariance for a (method, design) pair
.run_engine()
Estimation engine: weights to tidy output
.infer_design()
Infer the cluster-level assignment design
